content.subject: Apparel fulfillment expansion and ops reconciliation
content.draft_text:
Hi Devin,
ShipMonk launched an apparel-specific fulfillment center to tackle returns and SKU complexity. Such expansion pushes ops teams into more significant manual reconciliation work when complex SKU counts rise sharply.
We build bots that reconcile inventory movements across systems, reducing manual entry errors.
Can we schedule a detailed call next week to explore if this fits your priorities?
Zamp
